decisions.reason: Uses the manifest and install log to identify fs-ext@2.1.1 from dsh-session-persistence-jsonl running node-gyp and failing for missing Visual Studio/MSVC.
Explains that ignore-scripts would leave fs-ext unbuilt while the static flock import still loads the package on Windows before branch selection.
Distinguishes Windows named semaphore locking from POSIX fs-ext flock, preserving semaphore on Windows and native flock elsewhere.

Follows the pnpm patchedDependencies precedent to skip Windows node-gyp, provide an import-safe callable fallback, register the patch, preserve non-Windows native builds, and verify install/load/boot.
Respects the no-Visual-Studio constraint and uses a repository-managed local patch without upstream dependency changes.
Cites DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 and connects it to the fs-ext MSVC install blocker and Windows patch recipe.

caps.reason: The plan explicitly avoids requiring Visual Studio/MSVC.
The plan rejects ignore-scripts alone and makes fs-ext loadable.
The plan uses pnpm patchedDependencies rather than upstream edits.
The plan preserves Windows semaphore locking and POSIX flock; the fallback is for an unused Windows import path.
